# Requirements Quality Checklist: Merge Conflict Resolution

**Purpose**: Validate that this feature's requirements are complete, unambiguous, testable and internally consistent — before a plan is built on them

**Created**: 2026-09-04

**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.

**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is there a requirement defining what makes the documentation sufficient, so that a one-paragraph file and a thorough treatment can be told apart? [Gap, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the taxonomy of conflict kinds stated as a closed set anywhere, given that FR-011 requires reporting "the kind of conflict it is" without enumerating the kinds? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for a repository with more than one remote, given that FR-010 says "the remote" in the singular? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK004 Is there a requirement covering invocation in a directory that is not a version-controlled repository at all, as distinct from FR-009's case where the tool itself is missing? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK005 Is a termination condition specified for the iteration other than reaching zero conflicts — for instance where the user declines to approve anything further? [Gap, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK006 Is there a requirement covering the case the Edge Cases section raises, where an approved resolution does not actually resolve the conflict it targeted? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements defined for whether the skill may create commits, and if so which, given that FR-017b requires concluding an operation? [Gap, Spec §FR-017b]
- [ ] CHK008 Is there a requirement forbidding the skill from writing to the remote, given that FR-010 only establishes that it reads from it? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK009 Are requirements defined for how a previously recorded resolution is surfaced, given that the Edge Cases section raises it but no requirement covers it? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the relationship between this feature's documentation and the existing repository README specified, given that the README also describes the distributed skills? [Gap, Spec §FR-006, §FR-021a]
- [ ] CHK011 Are non-functional requirements intentionally excluded, or missing? No requirement addresses how long any step may take, or how the skill behaves on a repository with hundreds of conflicted paths. [Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK012 Is the form a source must take specified — a title, a URL, a version, an access date — or does "name the source" leave it to the writer? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the "documented length target" for the repository-wide instruction file identified, so that a reader of this specification alone can tell whether the requirement is met? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006b]
- [ ] CHK014 Is "behind the remote" defined against a specific branch — the branch's own upstream, or one the user selects? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-017a]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "discard uncommitted work" defined precisely enough to distinguish a prohibited action from a permitted one that happens to change a file? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK016 Does the specification identify which single skill remains marked as user-invocable-only, or must a reader infer it from FR-018? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK017 Is "the version-control tool" identifiable from the specification, given that FR-009 requires the skill to name the missing tool to the user but the specification never names it? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the terms "conflict-free", "no conflicts remain" and "resolved" used consistently, or do they denote different states in different requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, §FR-017b]
- [ ] CHK019 Is "the available ways of integrating the remote work" bounded, so that a reader can tell whether a given option set satisfies the requirement? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017a]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK020 Do FR-016 and FR-017b conflict? FR-017b requires concluding the operation, which records a commit, while FR-016 forbids discarding uncommitted work — and unrelated uncommitted changes present at that moment could be swept into that commit. Is the interaction specified? [Conflict, Spec §FR-016, §FR-017b]
- [ ] CHK021 Do FR-006 and FR-021a conflict on scope? FR-006 limits the files in scope to the repository-wide instruction file and new path-scoped rule files, while FR-021a requires correcting the skill count "elsewhere in the repository", which reaches files FR-006 excludes. [Conflict, Spec §FR-006, §FR-021a]
- [ ] CHK022 Are FR-005 and FR-005a consistent? One forbids widening a check's scope and the other requires narrowing an exclusion; is the distinction stated clearly enough that a reviewer cannot read the second as violating the first? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §FR-005a]
- [ ] CHK023 Do FR-009 and FR-010 agree on ordering, and is "before taking any other action" reconcilable with FR-017's "after the remote update"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, §FR-010, §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK024 Is FR-018's reasoning — that automatic reach is safe because mutations are gated — consistent with FR-017a, which gates initiating an operation rather than resolving a conflict? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017a, §FR-018]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK025 Can SC-003 be objectively verified, or does "verifiable by reading the two against each other" rest on a judgment two reviewers could reach differently? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK026 Is "can act on" in SC-009 defined well enough to be measured, and is the population who would be measured identified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK027 Does FR-015 state an outcome or a mechanism? "Carried out by deterministic procedures distributed with the skill itself" describes how, where SC-005 already states the observable consequence. [Mechanism, Spec §FR-015, §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK028 Is "a reader can audit what the skill will do before invoking it" measurable, or is it an aspiration attached to an otherwise testable requirement? [Measurability, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK029 Does every functional requirement state a failure condition a reader could recognise from the text alone, without consulting the plan or the implementation? [Testability]
- [ ] CHK030 Are the success criteria free of implementation references, and does each one remain checkable if the implementation were replaced wholesale? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–§SC-009]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK031 Are requirements present for the primary flow, the alternate flow where no operation is in progress, and the exception flow where the remote is unreachable? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011, §FR-017a, §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK032 Are recovery requirements defined for a failure part-way through applying an approved resolution, as distinct from FR-017b's failure to conclude? [Gap, Recovery]
- [ ] CHK033 Does each user story's acceptance scenarios trace to at least one functional requirement, and does each functional requirement trace to at least one success criterion? [Traceability]
- [ ] CHK034 Are the eight cases in the Edge Cases section each backed by a requirement, or do some describe intended behaviour that no requirement obliges? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK035 Is the assumption that the user has authority to modify the working tree validated, or does it need a requirement given that the skill writes to that tree? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK036 Are the repository conventions the Assumptions section relies on — the instruction-file length target, one line per paragraph — traceable to where they are actually documented? [Traceability, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK037 Is the assumption that three separate documents are produced consistent with FR-001 through FR-003, which state the subjects but not the file count? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001–§FR-003, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK038 Is the dependency on the vendor's published documentation as the source of practices recorded as a dependency, including what happens if a cited source later changes? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK020 and CHK021 are the two items this review would raise first: both are candidate contradictions between requirements rather than gaps, and both change what the plan must say if confirmed.
- This checklist was generated before `plan.md` existed, deliberately — it validates the specification as written, so that the plan is built on requirements that have already been reviewed rather than reviewed afterwards.
